limits: React Strict DOM primitives verified in actual Expo Go iOS/Android and production Expo Web; this does not establish visual parity or every API.
Native scroll uses documented compat.native and real RN ScrollView. Material shader is web-only; native finish static.
Twofold app text enlargement was exercised by real native controls. OS Dynamic Type/font-scale is outside these compiled scenarios.
Native fontSize is declared and source-bound, not read from a native computed-style API. Native region width and single-line height are measured directly.
Devices are iOS Simulator/Android emulator; physical hardware energy, thermal behavior, full accessibility and native release-build performance remain unverified.
